protocol_content.title: Reduced-dose versus full-dose apixaban for extended treatment of cancer-associated venous thromboembolism
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults with active cancer receiving extended anticoagulation after at least six months of treatment for venous thromboembolism, compare reduced-dose with full-dose apixaban for the efficacy and safety outcomes specified by the Review.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include randomized controlled trials comparing apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily with apixaban 5 mg twice daily for extended treatment after at least six months of anticoagulation in adults with active cancer and venous thromboembolism. Extract directly reported participant counts and outcome-specific denominators through 12 months.

result_targets.population: Adults with active cancer and venous thromboembolism who completed at least six months of anticoagulation and entered randomized extended treatment.
result_targets.outcome: Recurrent venous thromboembolism or bleeding composite
result_targets.outcome_definition: Composite of recurrent venous thromboembolism and bleeding as defined for the Review analysis.
result_targets.timepoint: 12 months after randomization to extended treatment.
result_targets.analysis_population: Participants analyzed in the randomized groups for the selected outcome.
result_targets.selection_rule: Use the randomized extended-treatment comparison and extract the participant event count and outcome-specific arm denominator reported through 12 months.
